description: This Java source file defines the configuration class for the MQTT protocol adapter in the Eclipse Hono project. It includes bean definitions, configuration properties, and setup for connection event producers, metrics, and adapter instantiation.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for the MQTT protocol adapter, providing bean definitions, property setup, and connection event producer configuration.

methods.name: vertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of VertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapter.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamSenderFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides configuration to set the name for downstream sender factory if not already set.

methods.name: customizeRegistrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides configuration to set the name for registration client factory if not already set.

methods.name: customizeCredentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides configuration to set the name for credentials client factory if not already set.

methods.name: customizeTenantClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides configuration to set the name for tenant client factory if not already set.

methods.name: adapterProperties
methods.description: Provides MQTT adapter configuration properties as a Spring bean, mapped to 'hono.mqtt' prefix.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Configures and returns a MeterRegistryCustomizer to add common tags for metrics.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory bean for producing VertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapter instances.

methods.name: connectionEventProducerLogging
methods.description: Provides a connection event producer that logs events, used as default.

methods.name: connectionEventProducerEvents
methods.description: Provides a connection event producer that sends events to the Hono event system.
